rawText:
Hannah Abbott
Lead SEO Strategist & Content Operations Manager
Chicago, IL | hannah.abbott@seomail.com | +1 312-555-0186 | linkedin.com/in/hannahabbott-seo

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Data-driven Lead SEO Strategist and Content Operations Manager with 7+ years of experience scaling organic traffic, content marketing engines, and technical SEO architecture for high-growth tech and e-commerce brands. Expert in keyword research, content clustering, technical SEO auditing, on-page optimization, and editorial workflow management. Scaled organic search traffic from 250K to 2.4M monthly visits and generated $5.6M in organic revenue.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Lead SEO & Content Strategist | GrowthPulse Media | Chicago, IL | 2021 - Present
- Spearheaded organic search growth strategy across 3 web properties, growing monthly organic visits from 250K to 2.4M (860% growth) in 24 months.
- Managed an editorial team of 8 in-house content writers and 15 freelance contributors, publishing 60+ high-ranking articles per month.
- Conducted comprehensive technical SEO audits using Screaming Frog and Google Search Console, fixing 1,200+ crawl errors, redirect loops, and Core Web Vitals issues.
- Designed topic cluster architecture and programmatic SEO templates that captured 450+ page-one Google search rankings for high-intent keywords.
- Implemented schema markup (Structured Data, JSON-LD) across 5,000+ product and blog pages, increasing SERP rich snippet click-through rate by 34%.

Senior SEO Specialist | BrandCraft Digital | Evanston, IL | 2018 - 2021
- Executed full-funnel keyword research and competitive gap analysis using Ahrefs and Semrush for 12 enterprise e-commerce clients.
- Built high-authority digital PR and backlink acquisition campaigns, acquiring 350+ editorial backlinks from domains with DR 70+.
- Collaborated with UX and Web Engineering teams to improve site speed and mobile responsiveness, increasing average time on page by 45%.
- Tracked organic KPIs and revenue attribution in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Looker Studio, presenting monthly performance insights to executives.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Arts in Journalism & Digital Media | Northwestern University | 2014 - 2018

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- SEO Strategy & Research: Technical SEO Audits, Keyword Research, Search Intent Mapping, Competitor Analysis, Topic Clusters, Schema Markup (JSON-LD)
- SEO & Analytics Tools: Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Looker Studio, Moz
- Content Management & Ops: WordPress, Webflow, Contentful, HubSpot, Clearscope, SurferSEO, Editorial Calendars, Asana
- Technical Knowledge: HTML, CSS, JavaScript basics, XML Sitemaps, Robots.txt, Canonical Tags, Core Web Vitals

CERTIFICATIONS
- Google Analytics 4 Certification (2023)
- Semrush Technical SEO Certification (2022)
- HubSpot Inbound Marketing Certification (2021)
jobDescriptionText:
Seeking a Lead SEO & Content Strategist to drive organic growth. Requirements:
- 5+ years experience in technical SEO, keyword research, and organic content marketing.
- Proficiency with Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, and Google Search Console.
- Demonstrated success scaling organic website traffic and editorial content teams.
- Deep understanding of technical SEO, schema markup, and GA4 tracking.
